name: Caspin Resources Limited
summary: Caspin Resources Limited operates as a mineral exploration company in Australia. The company focuses on gold, nickel, copper, and cobalt minerals. It holds a 100% interest in the Mount Squires project, which covers an area of 750km sq located in northwest of Perth, Western Australia; and an 80% in the Yarawindah project covering an area of 400 km sq located in northeast of Perth. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
